title: Start of the Kali Yuga era
summary: Beginning of the Kali Yuga, the fourth of the Hindu (also Chinese and Persian) ages, an era used to date the Flood and later events.
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-23. CFAH reads the Hindu yugas as a scaled count of real years and fixes the Kali Yuga by durations and a planetary conjunction. Added by the CFAH pass.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: February 7, 3104 B.C. (AP-23)

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-23: Kali Yuga: February 7, 3104 B.C." and subsection "Astronomical Calculation of Kali Yuga: February 7, 3104 B.C."
chronologies.note: Planetary conjunction calculated by Abhyankar. Hindu reckoning gives 3102 B.C., Chinese 3104, Persian 3103; CFAH-3 uses January 1, 3104 B.C. "for simplicity". The Fig. 9 caption reads "February 6, 3104 B.C.".
